learning_outcomes.text: Can distinguish between active and passive vehicle safety and the basics of automated driving.
Understand regulations from laws and consumer protection.
Can discuss protective measures for occupants and external road users, as well as measures to improve compatibility.
Can classify the functions and potentials of driver assistance systems and distinguish between sensors and actuators of assistance systems.
Gain insight into the development of automated driving functions.
Understand experimental and computational methods in vehicle safety.

syllabus_topics: Legislation and Consumer Protection in Vehicle Safety
Development and Potential of Driver Assistance Systems
Sensor Technology for Driver Assistance Systems
Sensor Data Fusion and Environment Presentation
Actuator Technology for Driver Assistance Systems
Levels of Driver Assistance (Stability, Lane Keeping and Navigation)
Further Development of Assistance Systems – Automated Driving
Introduction Scenarios for Automated Driving Functions
Societal and Individual Acceptance of Automated Driving
